title: Cake, TV Asahi Partner to Distribute Doraemon Anime in English
content: CAKE added it and TV Asahi "will also produce a new English-language version with the aim of refreshing the Doraemon library for English-speaking audiences and introducing a timeless Japanese icon to new viewers." ANN reached out to CAKE and TV Asahi for clarification on the wording of "new English-language version"…
author: ANN

title: Madoka Magica -Walpurgisnacht: Rising- Anime Film's Full Trailer Unveils Fiction Junction's Theme Song
content: Aniplex started streaming on Sunday the full trailer for Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising - ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film .
author: ANN

title: Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising Movie Unveils Main Trailer
content: The upcoming Puella Magi Madoka Magica: Walpurgisnacht Rising movie unveiled its main trailer featuring the theme song by FictionJunction on Monday. It is set to premiere in Japan on August 28 . Studio Shaft will animate the movie.
author: Anime Corner

title: WIT Studio Produces 'LONA' Original TV Anime Announced for Spring 2027
content: An official website opened for an original television anime titled LONA ( Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis ) on Sunday, revealing the main cast, production staff, three teaser visuals (pictured), and a teaser promotional video.
author: MyAnimeList

title: After Only 2 Years, Major Shonen Jump Series Officially Ends With Final Chapter – Read Now
content: It’s the end of year another major series within the pages of Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine as it has released its final chapter after only two years of serialization. This year has seen a few major releases come to an end with the magazine, but this Summer has been one of the strangest thus far.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll’s Breakout Action Fantasy Confirms Season 3 Return After Finale
content: A major breakout action fantasy anime from the Spring 2026 anime season has ended with Crunchyroll , but has thankfully confirmed Season 3 is now in the works. We’re now seeing the final few anime of the Spring 2026 season come to an end since there’s a whole new wave of releases coming this July as part of the Summer…
author: ComicBook

title: 3 Great Family Guy Characters Who Disappeared For Years
content: For decades, Peter, Lois, Meg, Chris, Stewie, and Brian have become the biggest animated family on Fox, thanks to Seth MacFarlane’s Family Guy . Throughout the legendary show’s history, there have been quite a few different characters who made some wild appearances but were relegated to a state of limbo.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners Sequel Finally Confirms Netflix Release Window With First Look Revealed
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners is now in the works on returning to Netflix with a brand new sequel series later this year, and has finally revealed when fans will be able to check it out in action with the first full look at its new cast of characters.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Diamond no Ace: Act II Second Season' Second Cour Announced for Fall 2026
content: • The official website of the Diamond no Ace ( Ace of Diamond ) anime series announced the second cour of the Diamond no Ace: Act II Second Season ( Ace of Diamond Act II Season 2 ) anime on Sunday, revealing a teaser visual (pictured).
author: MyAnimeList

title: Sentimental Graffiti Dating Simulation Game Gets Remake
content: The Weekly Famitsu magazine's live-streamed 40th anniversary event announced on Sunday that production has begun on Entergram's remake of NEC Interchannel 's classic dating simulation game Sentimental Graffiti .
author: ANN
